address: 186 chemin de l'Informel, Saint-Jean-Lespinasse, Saint-Céré, 46400, France
bio: This is the informal sibling of the Michelin-starred Les Trois Soleils de Montal. The chef rustles up generous, tasty traditional cuisine, made with fresh seasonal ingredients. Mouth-watering examples include a fillet of Aubrac beef, confit shallots and a tarragon-laced emulsion. Friendly and casual....
